remainingUiFindings.title: Sidebar search entry has no visible field in light mode, unlike dark mode
remainingUiFindings.evidence: shell-page__th-desktop-light.png x16–271 y128–172: fill #f6f7f9 equals the sidebar canvas (#f6f7f9) and the border is #ebeced (about 1.1:1), so the main HR navigation entry reads as a faint label, while shell-page__en-desktop-dark.png shows a filled, bordered field. The same applies to the drawer copy in shell-drawer__th-mobile-light.png y305–399. Source: SearchTriggers.tsx:100 (`border border-sidebar-border/60 bg-raised`), globals.css:141 (`--token-raised: var(--muted)`) and globals.css:223 (`--sidebar: #f6f7f9`).
remainingUiFindings.fix: In light mode, give the trigger the page search field's treatment: `bg-surface` with `border-input`, as on the Finished goods search box at y258. That gives at least a 3:1 boundary against the sidebar and matches the dark rendering.
remainingUiFindings.benchmark: Linear / Raycast: the search bar is a clearly bounded field that is the obvious way in

remainingUiFindings.title: Phone page search placeholder is cut mid-glyph with no ellipsis
remainingUiFindings.evidence: shell-page__th-mobile-light.png y772–868: the placeholder ends 'หรือหน่' with the following glyph sliced off. shell-page__en-mobile-dark.png shows 'Search SKU, name or stc' cut the same way. messages/th.json:1459. This belongs to the Finished goods toolbar, not the shell, but it is visible on this screen at 390 px.
remainingUiFindings.fix: Use a shorter placeholder below the sm breakpoint (for example 'ค้นหารหัสหรือชื่อสินค้า' / 'Search SKU or name'), or add `placeholder:text-ellipsis` with `text-overflow: ellipsis` on the input so the cut ends on an ellipsis.

remainingUiFindings.title: Drawer close button looks pressed in dark mode but flat in light mode
remainingUiFindings.evidence: shell-drawer__en-mobile-dark.png x458–550 y26–118 shows a filled raised tile behind X at rest. In shell-drawer__th-mobile-light.png the same button has no fill. The cause is the ghost variant's `aria-expanded:bg-raised` (buttonVariants.ts ghost) applied to the disclosure, which carries aria-expanded (DesktopShell.tsx:170). The desktop sidebar toggle does the same in shell-page__en-desktop-dark.png x236–270 y13–46.
remainingUiFindings.fix: Add `aria-expanded:bg-transparent` to NavigationDisclosure's className. Its icon (X / PanelLeft) already shows the state, so dark and light render the same at rest.

remainingUiFindings.title: Light-mode rail marks the current page by icon hue alone
remainingUiFindings.evidence: shell-rail__th-desktop-light.png x8–56 y196–244: the active tile is #eff6ff on the #f6f7f9 rail (about 1.03:1), so the only visible cue is a blue icon (#1c4dd8) against dark-grey siblings (#4f5662). With no label in the rail, the state depends on colour. Dark mode (shell-rail__en-desktop-dark.png) shows a clearly visible grey tile. Source: globals.css:223/227, sidebar.tsx:340 (`group-data-[collapsible=icon]:data-active:bg-sidebar-accent!`).
remainingUiFindings.fix: Give the light-mode active row a tile with at least 3:1 contrast against the rail (a stronger sidebar-accent token, or bg-surface with a border-strong ring), or add a 3 px inset indicator bar on `data-active`, so the state does not rely on hue. Apply the same token to the expanded sidebar and the drawer.

remainingUiFindings.title: Text language button squeezes the organisation name on Thai phones
remainingUiFindings.evidence: locale-switch__en-mobile-dark.png and shell-page__th-mobile-light.png header: the 'English' button takes about 92 css px, so the organisation name truncates to 'Industrial SAS Lo…'. With 'ไทย' it shows 'Industrial SAS Local …'. The full name exists only in a title attribute, which phones cannot reach. Source: LocaleSwitcher.tsx:48; DesktopShell.tsx HeaderBrand.
remainingUiFindings.fix: Below sm, show a compact own-name label ('EN' / 'ไทย', keeping lang and the sr-only 'switch to'), or reduce the button's horizontal padding (px-2), so the organisation name keeps about 10 more characters.

remainingUiFindings.title: The pending AI row drops the AI's scope, so a warehouse request waits on an AI that only covers HR topics
remainingUiFindings.evidence: All four search-ai-running images, pending row ('AI is reading your request…' / 'AI กำลังตีความคำขอ…' + Cancel) shows no detail line; the query is 'pallets of DEMO-DRINK' on /finished-goods. messages/en.json Search.aiScope = 'AI takes you to pages and forms for time, leave, requests and employees.'; SearchDialog.tsx:964-981 (AiRunning renders only spinner, status text and Cancel)
remainingUiFindings.fix: Keep the Ask row's scope sentence (Search.aiScope) as a text-xs text-muted second line under the AiRunning status text, the same detail the row carried before it was pressed, so the member sees what the AI can and cannot answer while waiting

remainingUiFindings.title: The only typed result is the page already open, shown in the selected style, and in English it carries no visible match

remainingUiFindings.fix: Do not give the current page the active/selected fill while an AI request is pending, and rank a 'This page' result below other matches; when a result matched on a keyword rather than its title, show that keyword as the muted trail text so the reason is visible
remainingUiFindings.benchmark: Linear: matching terms highlighted in titles; GitHub: current location used as scope, not offered as a result

remainingUiFindings.title: The header organisation slot is a bare skeleton bar that never resolves during the outage, while the sidebar names the same unknown in words
remainingUiFindings.evidence: shell-loading__th-mobile-light.png and __en-mobile-dark.png, header between the menu and search buttons (x≈68–218, y≈22–42 CSS): an unlabeled grey pill. shell-loading__th-desktop-light.png, header top-left (x≈316–476, y≈16–36): the same pill. The sidebar's 'Current warehouse' region says 'กำลังรอการเชื่อมต่อ… / Waiting for connection…' as text (en-desktop aria: region 'Current warehouse' → text 'Waiting for connection…'), and the mobile banner aria has no organisation node at all.
remainingUiFindings.fix: Render the organisation slot the way the sidebar warehouse region does once the connection banner is up: muted text 'กำลังรอการเชื่อมต่อ…' (text-muted, same size as the org name), or the last known organisation name if it is cached. Keep the pulsing skeleton only for the first few seconds before the 'can't reach the server' banner appears.

remainingUiFindings.title: On the phone the brand bar is centred with the message, so the wordmark and language switch float mid-screen and the theme toggle is missing
remainingUiFindings.evidence: not-found__th-mobile-light.png and not-found__en-mobile-dark.png: the 'โยงกิจ / Yongkit' row and the language button sit at y≈320–330 CSS, with about 300 px of blank space above them, so they read as part of the message instead of page chrome. On desktop (not-found__th-desktop-light.png) the same row floats at y≈365 in the middle of the 1440 canvas. Source: not-found.tsx:24-27 'flex min-h-dvh … justify-center' wraps the brand row and the message together. No theme toggle is present, although every other screen has one in the header (D7).
remainingUiFindings.fix: Move the brand row out of the centred block into a top header strip (the same px-4 h-14 header layout and border-b as the signed-in shell header), containing LocaleSwitcher and ThemeToggle from src/components/ui/theme-toggle.tsx. Then put the message block in the upper third (justify-start with pt-16 on phones, a centred max-w-xl on desktop).

remainingUiFindings.title: English cause line opens with a dangling "Its"
remainingUiFindings.evidence: route-error__en-mobile-dark.png and route-error__en-desktop-dark.png, red notice title "Its data didn't load. This may be temporary."; messages/en.json:207 (Error.pageCause). The Thai line "โหลดข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ อาจเป็นปัญหาชั่วคราว" (messages/th.json:207) has no such problem.

remainingUiFindings.title: Breadcrumb's current crumb repeats the h1, and three controls lead to the same hub
remainingUiFindings.evidence: route-error__th-mobile-light.png top: breadcrumb "สินค้าสำเร็จรูป > เปิดหน้านี้ไม่ได้" sits directly over the h1 "เปิดหน้านี้ไม่ได้". The breadcrumb link, the Back arrow and the outline button "ไปที่หน้าสินค้าสำเร็จรูป" all offer a way to Finished goods. src/components/ui/PageBreadcrumbs.tsx:64; src/app/[locale]/(desktop)/error.tsx:80-90
remainingUiFindings.fix: When PageFailure receives breadcrumbs, render only the hub crumb (or label the current crumb with the record type, for example "สินค้า" / "Product") so the h1 is not repeated. Keep the Back arrow and the outline recovery button as they are (D5, D11).

remainingFindings.title: Desktop mixed results conceal continuation below an orphaned heading
remainingFindings.evidence: search-results--mixed__en-desktop-dark.png, bottom of results panel: “Tasks (2)” appears without either task, immediately above the keyboard footer. No visible scrollbar or continuation cue identifies the remaining tasks and AI row. The accessibility snapshot contains those options; src/components/shell/search/SearchDialog.tsx:606 caps the scroll area, while :652 renders group headings independently. The mobile mixed capture exposes its task and AI row clearly.
remainingFindings.fix: Keep the existing listbox and result order, but add an overflow-only continuation cue using border, surface, and muted-text tokens. Keep each group heading visible with its first option when sizing the viewport, and make the scroll affordance visible above the keyboard footer.

remainingFindings.title: Repeated connection messages weaken the outage hierarchy
remainingFindings.evidence: shell-loading__th-mobile-light.png and shell-loading__en-mobile-dark.png: the header and content card repeat “Waiting for connection” around an already explanatory warning banner; the header copy is truncated. Desktop variants repeat it again under Current warehouse. src/components/shell/DesktopShell.tsx:195–213 confirms the header repetition.
remainingFindings.fix: Keep ConnectionNotice as the prominent outage explanation and recovery action. Shorten HeaderBrand's unresolved connection label and use a concise data-unavailable label in the existing LedgerPanelStatus, retaining the reserved content layout and existing tokens.

remainingFindings.title: Retry feedback shifts the adjacent recovery action
remainingFindings.evidence: Comparing route-error__en-desktop-dark.png with route-error--retrying__en-desktop-dark.png, the retry button expands when its spinner appears, moving “Go to Finished goods” approximately 24px right. src/components/shell/PageFailure.tsx:79 conditionally inserts the spinner without reserving space.
remainingFindings.fix: Reserve a fixed spinner slot inside the existing Button, using the existing Spinner and spacing tokens, so both recovery controls retain their positions while retrying.

remainingFindings.title: English sidebar search trigger drops the verb that the Thai trigger keeps
remainingFindings.evidence: shell-page__en-desktop-dark.png, sidebar search trigger at about x=16-270, y=128-172 reads 'Pages or employees…', while shell-page__th-desktop-light.png shows 'ค้นหาเมนูหรือพนักงาน…' ('Search menus or employees…'); messages/en.json:3132 vs messages/th.json:3132. The accessible name keeps 'Search pages or employees' (messages/en.json:3134), so only the visible text differs.
remainingFindings.fix: Change Search.triggerPeople in messages/en.json to 'Search pages or people…' (or 'Search pages, employees…') so the visible placeholder starts with a verb like the Thai one and the trigger reads as a search box at a glance; keep the ⌘K kbd chip.
remainingFindings.benchmark: Raycast: the placeholder says what can be searched in the current context

remainingFindings.title: Current-page row is drawn as a third outlined box, so it reads like another input under the warehouse select and the search field
remainingFindings.evidence: shell-drawer__th-mobile-light.png and shell-drawer__en-mobile-dark.png, top of the drawer from y≈184 to y≈624 (2× px): the warehouse combobox, the search trigger and the active 'สินค้าสำเร็จรูป / Finished goods' row are all full-width rounded rectangles with a 1px grey border. In dark mode the active row differs from the search box only by a grey fill. Source: sidebarRow.ts:15 (data-active inset 1px border-strong ring) and SearchTriggers.tsx:100 (border border-input). The same stack appears in the expanded desktop sidebar in shell-page__th-desktop-light.png (x 16-270, y 80-280).
remainingFindings.fix: Drop the inset border-strong ring from data-active in sidebarRowClassName and mark the current page with the sidebar's selected surface alone (bg-sidebar-accent with text-sidebar-accent-foreground plus a 3px left accent bar in the brand token). Keep borders only on the two real controls (warehouse select and search trigger), so controls look like controls and the current location looks like a location.

remainingFindings.title: On the icon rail the search button and the current page are two near-identical outlined squares
remainingFindings.evidence: shell-rail__en-desktop-dark.png, rail x≈8-56: the search square at y≈124-172 and the active Finished goods square at y≈196-244 both have a rounded 1px grey outline; the only difference is a dark-grey fill on the active one. In shell-rail__th-desktop-light.png the active square adds a pale blue fill and blue icon, so the two themes signal 'current page' with different strength. Source: SearchTriggers.tsx:100 (border border-input on the search row) and sidebarRow.ts:15 (active inset border-strong ring).
remainingFindings.fix: On the rail, render the search trigger as a plain ghost icon row (no border, keep the tooltip and ⌘K in its name) and show the current destination with the selected surface token (bg-sidebar-accent, icon in text-sidebar-accent-foreground) without the outline, identical in both themes. A thin divider between the search row and the Warehouse group already exists in the expanded sidebar and can be reused.

remainingFindings.title: Thai placeholder says 'menu' while the English placeholder, dialog description and group headings say 'pages'
remainingFindings.evidence: search-empty__th-mobile-light.png and search-empty__th-desktop-light.png, input placeholder 'ค้นหาเมนูหรือพนักงาน' vs search-empty__en-mobile-dark.png 'Search pages or employees'; the a11y description and typed group heading use 'หน้า ส่วนงาน' / 'หน้าและส่วนงาน'; messages/th.json:3142-3143
remainingFindings.fix: Use one term in Thai: change Search.placeholderPeople to 'ค้นหาหน้าหรือพนักงาน' and Search.placeholder to 'ค้นหาหน้าหรือส่วนงาน', matching the 'หน้าและส่วนงาน' group heading

remainingFindings.title: Every employee row repeats the same link-coloured 'Open the employee form' line, making each record three lines tall

remainingFindings.title: On desktop the list is capped short, so the Tasks group is cut off under its heading and the AI row is hidden with no scroll cue

remainingFindings.title: Matched-alias line under the page result is a bare bold link-coloured word that reads like a tag or link, and in Thai repeats the title's highlighted word

remainingFindings.title: The pending AI row loses the look of the AI row it replaces and floats after a large gap, so it reads as a separate widget rather than the AI row in progress
